IncidentBot: Pager: GPU pool 'hotpath-prod' at 92% sustained GPU utilization and request queue length growing >6000. Threshold breached for 5m. Severity: P1. @#oncall
Alex (oncall): On it. I’m pulling up autoscale logs and current replicas.
Alex (oncall): `kubectl get hpa -n inference hotpath --output=json | jq '.status'` shows desiredReplicas 6, currentReplicas 6, maxReplicas 6. Autoscaler hit max.
Maria (sre): Ugh, maxReplicas == 6 is the problem. Who set the max so low for this pool?
Jamal (infra): That was part of the cost cap from last quarter — forgot to bump after traffic growth. I can lift to 12 manually but need approval for transient budget increase.
Jen (runtime): Traffic has a large burst of short-chat requests causing tiny sequences but many metadata-only calls. Token-bucket for standard tier is low bursting; clients get 429s which pile up in the queue.
Alex (oncall): Customers are seeing 429s? Any specific customers flagged?
Emma (cs): Yes, two paying accounts reported elevated 429s ~15:21 UTC; one has production traffic. They've opened tickets.
Maria (sre): Show me realtime 429 counters.
Alex (oncall): `redis-cli --latency` nah. Using metrics: `sum(rate(http_request_status{code="429",pool="hotpath"}[1m])) by (tier)` returns 180/m for standard, 24/m for premium.
Lee (ops): So premium is mostly ok but standard is melting. We should route premium to a different pool and free hotpath for mixed traffic.
Jamal (infra): I can spin up a dedicated 'hotpath-burst' pool on the same cluster with 4 GPUs, attach it to premium, and then raise autoscale max on original to 12.
Jen (runtime): Also recommend adjusting the per-tier token refill: standard refill=50/s, burst=100. We can temporarily increase to refill=150/s to reduce 429s while scale comes up.
Alex (oncall): Plan: 1) Increase maxReplicas for hotpath to 12. 2) Create hotpath-burst pool and route premium. 3) Bump standard token refill & burst. 4) Monitor queue and error rate. Anyone object?
Maria (sre): Go for it. Jamal please coordinate infra changes; Jen handle rate limiter toggle; Alex monitor.
Jamal (infra): Starting scale change: `kubectl patch hpa hotpath -n inference -p '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 12}}'` -> applied.
IncidentBot: DeployBot: hpa.hotpath patched by jamal at 15:25:12 UTC
Jamal (infra): Spinning up hotpath-burst: `rctl pool create hotpath-burst --gpus=4 --region=us-west1` -> requested capacity provisioning.
Jen (runtime): Changing rate limiter for standard tier: `rctl rate set --tier=standard --refill=150 --burst=300 --window=1s` (temporary) -> applied.
Alex (oncall): I'm seeing 429 rate drop from 180/m -> 90/m within 30s. Queue length: 6000 -> 4200.
Emma (cs): Customer A reported error spikes are decreasing. They see success rate improving.
Maria (sre): Nice. Keep an eye on latency — bumping refill can increase backend pressure.
Alex (oncall): Latency p50 increased from 120ms -> 220ms for hotpath, p95 up to 900ms. But success rate better.
Jamal (infra): hotpath-burst pool finished provisioning and we routed premium to it. Premium 429s -> 4/m.
Jen (runtime): Started evicting low-priority queued work for standard tier to free slots: `queuectl trim --pool=hotpath --policy=evict-low-priority --count=1500`.
Alex (oncall): After eviction queue is 2700. Still high but manageable. GPUs now 80%.
Maria (sre): Any cascade to other pools? Check cross-pool routing.
Jamal (infra): No significant spill; only transient routing while hotpath autoscaled. No nodes OOM/GPUs unhealthy.
Alex (oncall): Customer impact summary so far: - 2 customers saw 429s and elevated latency between 15:20–15:30. - No data loss, requests either retried client-side or permanently 429ed. - One enterprise customer reported production errors (now improving).
Emma (cs): I'm updating tickets: telling them we applied temporary fixes (bumped autoscale/fallback pool/rate limiter) and will follow up with RCA and timeline for permanent config change.
Maria (sre): Next steps: 1) Keep temp rate limits for 15 minutes while autoscale stabilizes. 2) Schedule config change to permanently bump hotpath maxReplicas to 12 this week with cost review. 3) Add an automated alert when HPA maxReplicas == currentReplicas AND queue growth > threshold. 4) Re-evaluate per-tier refill defaults.
Jen (runtime): Also propose we add a burst pool for spiky workloads so critical tiers can fall back without touching standard.
Alex (oncall): Agreed. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. If 429s return, we'll escalate to paging SRE lead.
Jamal (infra): FYI I reverted the temp rate change for standard at 15:43 after stable drop: `rctl rate set --tier=standard --refill=80 --burst=120` -> applied. We left hotpath maxReplicas=12 and hotpath-burst pool active.
IncidentBot: Incident update: Mitigation applied (autoscale max increased, new burst pool, token refill temporarily raised). Continue monitoring. Incident status: mitigation in place.
Alex (oncall): Final numbers at 15:52: 429s avg 6/m, queue length 210, GPU util 55%. Closing active mitigation window.
Emma (cs): I'll send an incident email and link to tickets + short customer-facing summary.
Maria (sre): Assign postmortem. Action items: update HPA defaults, add auto-alert when HPA capped AND queue growing, define burst pool runbook. Assign owners in PM.
Alex (oncall): Thanks team. Closing thread — will follow up with postmortem draft.
